notes.text: Completed the full second reading of this sheet only. Viewed original and both native halves once each, then seven existing crops. No new crop, enlarged half, OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used.

Only three physical guide additions are proposed. Étale, certains and si dim X=1 were already correctly read and are not new lexical readings. Their interlinear positions and attachments are now drawn with curves and no arrowheads.
The heading, both items, oblique instruction and full NB were reread word by word. No further text change is proposed. All four existing doubts and seven original MARKS decisions remain.
The finite-cover assertion and hole-operation descriptions were carried as source statements. Their mathematical plausibility did not supply obscured letters or resolve tt versus the quantifier.
The pencil pagination hand is unidentified. Top number stays unsure{6}; lower 11 is retained without assigning the purpose of the numbering systems.
The guide drawings use ordinary TikZ supported by the packet preamble. Source bent/two-branch shapes and attachments are represented without arrow tips. Only static verification was performed.
